item.title: Recipients of Ohio School Bus Safety Grants announced
item.description: COLUMBUS — Governor Mike DeWine and Ohio Department of Education and Workforce Director Stephen D. Dackin on Thursday, Jan. 22, announced the award of $10 million in Ohio School Bus Safety Grants to 371 schools, districts, and county boards of developmental disabilities statewide. The post Recipients of Ohio School Bus Safety Grants announced appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: New traffic pattern, 4-way stop installed
item.description: EATON — The Preble County Engineer’s Office has announced a permanent traffic pattern change at the intersection of Orphans Road and Eaton Gettysburg Road. The post New traffic pattern, 4-way stop installed appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: PCSO warns of fake deputy scam calls
item.description: EATON — The Preble County Sheriff’s Office is warning residents about a phone scam involving a caller falsely claiming to be a deputy with the department. The post PCSO warns of fake deputy scam calls appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Winter Crisis Program ongoing
item.description: DAYTON — Winter heating assistance for Miami Valley residents who are without heat or facing disconnection is available through the Winter Crisis Program, administered by the Miami Valley Community Action Partnership. The post Winter Crisis Program ongoing appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Reynolds resigns as PC Clerk of Courts
item.description: EATON — The Preble County Republican Executive Committee voted Thursday, Jan. 22, to remove Brionne Reynolds from the committee and formally requested her resignation from her position as Preble County Clerk of Courts, following allegations involving theft from a private business. The post Reynolds resigns as PC Clerk of Courts appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: City Council hears update on Public Works, approves CRA, property purchase
item.description: EATON — Eaton City Council received an update on major water system projects, approved a tax abatement for a new senior housing development and authorized the sale of excess equipment during its regular meeting Monday, Jan. 19. The post City Council hears update on Public Works, approves CRA, property purchase appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Council to secure funds for Westbrook
item.description: BROOKVILLE — Council approved by emergency the required legislation in order to secure the funds to be used in the resurfacing of a section of Westbrook Road. The post Council to secure funds for Westbrook appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Cultivation facility amendment rejected
item.description: BROOKVILLE — Council voted 4-3 not to accept the first reading of an ordinance amending the 2024 ordinance that allowed the cultivation, processing and laboratory testing of medical marijuana and adult-use cannabis in the city. The post Cultivation facility amendment rejected appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Clayton joins gas aggregation program
item.description: CLAYTON — At its January 15 meeting the City of Clayton passed a resolution to approve participation in the Miami Valley Communications Council Natural Gas Aggregation Program. The post Clayton joins gas aggregation program appeared first on The Register Herald.
